name: Julien Eparvier
source:
Entertainment is a virtuoso piano performer and singer at Le Parisien hotel and casino. He is mild-mannered, thoughtful, and romantic. As he is a performer, he is easy to find, but difficult to get close to. What secrets does Julien have? Perhaps a candlelight dinner, a romantic bottle of wine, and a night with him might reveal some... But then again... Some people find things regarding him very difficult to remember...

[From Kickstarter]
